name: Marvel's Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
description: Agent Phil Coulson of S.H.I.E.L.D. (Strategic Homeland Intervention, Enforcement and Logistics Division) puts together a team of agents to investigate the new, the strange and the unknown around the globe, protecting the ordinary from the extraordinary.

videos.title: Special Look
videos.overview: Teaser of Joss Whedon's new TV Show where the cast present their characters and Joss Whedon (Executive producer/Director/Writer) outlines the premise.

videos.title: Double Agent: Infiltrating the Set
videos.overview: In the digital series premiere, a Double Agent infiltrates the set of Marvel’s Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. Working for a shadowy figure known only as the Mastermind, he encounters series regular Ming-Na Wen (Agent May) and show co-creator Jed Whedon as he works to stay ahead of Marvel Security and uncover secrets of the show.

videos.title: Double Agent: Searching For Secrets
videos.overview: The Double Agent visits various production departments. He uses the opportunity to secretly gather intel for the Mastermind and in the process meets Adrianne Palicki (Agent Bobbi Morse), Costume Designer Ann Foley, and Prop Master Scott Bauer. But Marvel Security is always watching...

videos.title: Double Agent: Security Alert
videos.overview: The Mastermind gives the Double Agent his most dangerous mission yet. After a run-in with Brett Dalton (Grant Ward), the set is put on lockdown by Marvel Security. While in the midst of a desperate cat and mouse chase, our Double Agent has an unexpected interaction with Elizabeth Henstridge (Agent Simmons).

videos.title: Double Agent: Post Heist
videos.overview: The Double Agent is tasked with finding the Season 2 finale, but his mission does not go as planned. In the process of evading Marvel Security, he runs into Chloe Bennet (Agent Skye) and Post Producers Chris Cheramie and Robert Parigi.

videos.title: Double Agent: The Mastermind Is Revealed
videos.overview: On the run with a stolen copy of the Marvel’s Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. finale, the Double Agent finds himself in a desperate car chase with Marvel Security. The Mastermind’s true identity is revealed and our adventure culminates in a startling conclusion. Special appearance by Clark Gregg (Director Coulson).

videos.title: Academy: Recruitment
videos.overview: Three diehard fans attend a casting session only to find that they have actually just enrolled at the Marvel's Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.: Academy. Clark Gregg welcomes the new recruits and sends them off to begin the rigorous evaluation process. Do these recruits have what it takes to be a S.H.I.E.L.D. agent?

videos.title: Academy: Sci-Tech challenge
videos.overview: Elizabeth Henstridge (Agent Jemma Simmons) puts the Recruit's intelligence to the test inspired by the episode "Beginning of the End." The recruit must quickly solve a complex series of equations before time expires in order to rescue Fitz, who's trapped underwater.

videos.title: Academy: Skydive Challenge
videos.overview: The Recruit must prove that they are courageous enough for field work as a S.H.I.E.L.D. Agent by completing this high-altitude challenge inspired by Director Coulson’s perilous skydive in the episode "Closure". Ming-Na Wen (Agent Melinda May) and Henry Simmons (Agent Alphonso "Mack" Mackenzie) introduce the mission. Brett Dalton (Hive) makes a surprise visit and raises the stakes with a devious twist.

videos.title: Academy: Inhuman Adaptation Challenge
videos.overview: In this simulation, the Recruit assumes the role of a newly reborn Inhuman on the run from Hydra. The Recruit must race through an obstacle course and recover coordinates to a S.H.I.E.L.D. extraction point before his time expires. Luke Mitchell (Lincoln Campbell) encourages the Recruit along the way, but Brett Dalton (Hive) adds a high-speed twist to the challenge.

videos.title: Academy: Commencement
videos.overview: The Academy Recruits join Clark Gregg and the cast and crew of Marvel's Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D as they prepare for their big day playing agents on an episode of the hit show. Get a behind-the-scenes look as the Recruits go through hair, make-up, wardrobe and props before rehearsing their scene.

videos.title: Pilot
videos.overview: After the events of The Avengers, S.H.I.E.L.D. Agent Phil Coulson assembles a small team of agents to investigate a mysterious group called the Rising Tide. In doing so, they encounter Mike Peterson, a man who has acquired superhuman powers.

Coulson and his S.H.I.E.L.D. agents travel to Peru to investigate an object of unknown origin, codenamed 0-8-4. But when he runs into Comandante Camilla Reyes, more than just sparks fly at 30,000 feet.

videos.title: The Asset
videos.overview: When the brilliant scientist, Dr. Franklin Hall, is kidnapped, Agent Coulson and his S.H.I.E.L.D. agents must race against the clock to locate him. Skye is their only way in–pushing the team to their limits when the entire plan turns upside-down.

videos.title: Eye Spy
videos.overview: Agent Coulson and the S.H.I.E.L.D. team try to track down a mysterious woman who has single-handedly committed numerous high-stakes heists. But when the woman’s identity is revealed, a troubling secret stands to ruin Coulson.

videos.title: Girl in the Flower Dress
videos.overview: An elusive girl in a flower dress may hold the key to the mystery that brings Coulson and team to Asia to rescue a young man with an unusual and dangerous power; and Skye has a secret that jeopardizes her relationship with the team right when they need her most.

videos.title: FZZT
videos.overview: When floating bodies turn up, Coulson and the agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. must hunt down an elusive killer. No one is safe - not even the team.

videos.title: The Hub
videos.overview: Dangerous secrets are being kept from Coulson's Team, and he works the system to save Ward and Fitz when they are sent on a Level 8 classified mission that may end in tragedy.

videos.title: The Well
videos.overview: In the aftermath of the events chronicled in the feature film Marvel's Thor: The Dark World, Coulson and the agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. pick up the pieces–one of which threatens to destroy a member of the team.

videos.title: Repairs
videos.overview: Coulson and his team are haunted by a ghost that threatens to destroy them all, and only a secret from May's past can save them.

videos.title: The Bridge
videos.overview: In a shocking cliffhanger episode, Coulson takes the war back to Centipede, and this time he brings in Michael Peterson for some super-soldier support. As they get closer to the truth, startling secrets are revealed and an unexpected twist threatens the team.

videos.title: The Magical Place
videos.overview: S.H.I.E.L.D. organizes a full scale hunt for Coulson. Meanwhile, Coulson uncovers vital information about the mystery of his death, but, with Centipede out for blood, this knowledge may come at the cost of one of the team!

videos.title: Seeds
videos.overview: Coulson and May uncover startling information about Skye's past, while the team is swept into a storm at a S.H.I.E.L.D. Academy of Science and Technology.

videos.title: T.R.A.C.K.S.
videos.overview: Hot on the trail of The Clairvoyant, Coulson and his team board a mystery train that seems to be headed for certain death.

videos.title: T.A.H.I.T.I.
videos.overview: Coulson goes on the attack to save Skye by enlisting the aid of Ward's former S.O. John Garrett and uncovers shocking truths about his own life and S.H.I.E.L.D.

videos.title: Yes Men
videos.overview: When Coulson and his team are attacked by Lorelei - a deadly seductress who escaped from Asgard - Thor’s Lady Sif, her longtime nemesis, steps in to try to save them.

videos.title: End of the Beginning
videos.overview: Agents Garrett and Triplett are back to help Coulson's Team track down S.H.I.E.L.D.'s nefarious enemy--The Clairvoyant. But will Deathlok destroy them all to protect his master's identity?

videos.title: Turn, Turn, Turn
videos.overview: Coulson and his team find themselves without anyone they can trust, only to discover that they are trapped with a traitor in their midst.

videos.title: Providence
videos.overview: With Colonel Glenn Talbot now on their trail, Coulson and his team seek refuge in the last place anyone would look, where they begin to uncover S.H.I.E.L.D.'s most dangerous secrets. Secrets that could destroy them all.

videos.title: The Only Light in the Darkness
videos.overview: With their world turned upside down, Coulson races to save the life of his one true love as the mystery of "The Cellist," which began in Marvel's The Avengers, is finally revealed.

videos.title: Nothing Personal
videos.overview: Just when there's no one left to trust, Agent Maria Hill returns to team up with Coulson as S.H.I.E.L.D. is being destroyed around them.

videos.title: Ragtag
videos.overview: Ward's betrayal and HYDRA's shocking secrets are revealed as Coulson's team goes undercover on a mission that leaves no one unscathed.

videos.title: Beginning of the End
videos.overview: Dark secrets are revealed as Coulson and his team put everything on the line to stop Garrett and the forces of HYDRA.

videos.title: Shadows
videos.overview: Coulson and his team are now wanted fugitives with limited resources, but that's not stopping them from keeping the world safe from powerful and unseen threats everywhere. However, with new members they hardly know, will S.H.I.E.L.D. ever be trusted again?

videos.title: Heavy Is the Head
videos.overview: Hunted and running out of solutions, Phil Coulson puts his team right in the line of fire in the hopes of saving them all. But with General Glenn Talbot, HYDRA, and Carl Creel all on the attack, can they possibly survive? Meanwhile, a mysterious Doctor harbors some dangerous secrets that could destroy one of our core team members.

videos.title: Making Friends and Influencing People
videos.overview: Coulson and his team race against HYDRA to get to Donnie Gill--a dangerous gifted with the ability to freeze objects--while Simmons is caught in the crossfire.

videos.title: Face My Enemy
videos.overview: While on a mission to learn more about the secrets of the mysterious writing, Coulson finds himself attacked by the only person he can trust: Agent Melinda May. Meanwhile, the rest of the team is trapped in an explosive situation, and it's up to Fitz to save them--but is he up to it?

videos.title: A Hen in the Wolf House
videos.overview: Coulson's team is up against the beautiful and deadly Bobbi Morse--Security Chief for HYDRA. Meanwhile, Skye's father forces Raina to reunite him with his daughter at any cost.

videos.title: A Fractured House
videos.overview: The world turns against S.H.I.E.L.D. when HYDRA impersonates them to attack The United Nations, and an unexpected enemy leads the charge to bring about their downfall.

videos.title: The Writing on the Wall
videos.overview: The team discovers murder victims with the alien glyphs on them that Coulson's been etching. All of Coulson's secrets and lies come to a head.

videos.title: The Things We Bury
videos.overview: Coulson and team find themselves in an epic face-off against HYDRA to uncover an ancient secret, while Ward kidnaps his brother, Senator Christian Ward, for a violent trip down memory lane.

videos.title: ...Ye Who Enter Here
videos.overview: S.H.I.E.L.D. discovers the ancient city before HYDRA, but uncovering the secrets may require one of Coulson's team to make the ultimate sacrifice. Meanwhile, Melinda May and Skye race to get to Raina before Daniel Whitehall takes her.

videos.title: What They Become
videos.overview: Coulson and Whitehall's forces meet in an explosive confrontation that dramatically alters everyone's fates. Meanwhile, Skye discovers shocking secrets about her past.

videos.title: Aftershocks
videos.overview: Coulson's team must deal with the consequences of their war with HYDRA as shocking revelations threaten to tear them apart, and HYDRA makes a dangerous move that may involve a traitor in S.H.I.E.L.D.'s midst.

videos.title: Who You Really Are
videos.overview: Coulson and his team come to the aid of a confused Lady Sif, who has lost her memory after fighting with a mysterious warrior whose mission will send shockwaves through S.H.I.E.L.D. Meanwhile, Bobbi and Mack continue to hide their true mission from everyone close to them.

videos.title: One of Us
videos.overview: Cal seeks revenge on Coulson by assembling a team of Super Villains to destroy S.H.I.E.L.D. Meanwhile, May calls on renowned Dr. Andrew Garner, her charismatic ex-husband, with a crisis that threatens to tear the team apart.

videos.title: Love in the Time of Hydra
videos.overview: Coulson and his team are still reeling from a shocking revelation that leaves the team fractured as they must decide what to do with one of their own. Meanwhile, Bobbi and Mack reveal their true allegiance to Hunter, while elsewhere, Ward and Agent 33 embark on a personal mission.

videos.title: One Door Closes
videos.overview: War comes to Coulson's doorstep in a way he never anticipated as shocking revelations are brought to light, and Skye struggles to control her new abilities but will soon make a decision that irrevocably changes her life.

videos.title: Afterlife
videos.overview: As Robert Gonzales makes his move, Coulson must do whatever it takes to protect the future of S.H.I.E.L.D. Meanwhile Skye’s journey to control her powers takes a surprising turn when she meets the enigmatic Inhuman named Lincoln.

videos.title: Melinda
videos.overview: The story of Melinda May’s transformation into “The Cavalry” is revealed as she finds herself at a crossroads in the war between Coulson and Gonzales. As Skye learns more about her true heritage from Lincoln, the truth about the Inhumans will send her in a new direction.

videos.title: The Frenemy of My Enemy
videos.overview: A dangerous new alliance is formed as Coulson and Hunter turn to the last person anyone would expect – Grant Ward! As the war between S.H.I.E.L.D. factions continues, Skye and Lincoln will find themselves drawn into this conflict.

videos.title: The Dirty Half Dozen
videos.overview: Gonzales and Coulson must find a way to put their differences aside and work together against HYDRA, even if it means teaming up with someone they don't trust.

videos.title: Scars
videos.overview: Skye is torn between her loyalty to S.H.I.E.L.D. and her connection to the Inhumans as tensions rise between the groups -- and Coulson reveals a secret he's been hiding from even those closest to him.

videos.title: S.O.S. (1)
videos.overview: S.H.I.E.L.D. puts everything on the line to survive a war that blurs the line between friend and foe. Coulson and his team will be forced to make shocking sacrifices that will leave their relationships and their world changed forever.

videos.title: S.O.S. (2)
videos.overview: S.H.I.E.L.D. puts everything on the line to survive a war that blurs the line between friend and foe. Coulson and his team will be forced to make shocking sacrifices that will leave their relationships and their world changed forever.

videos.title: Laws of Nature
videos.overview: When a new Inhuman is discovered, Coulson and the team have an encounter with another organization seeking powered people; Fitz goes to extreme measures to determine how to get Simmons back.

videos.title: Purpose in the Machine
videos.overview: Fitz and the team enlist the aid of an Asgardian to unlock the secrets of the ancient Monolith that swallowed Simmons, and Agent May is at a crossroads in her personal and professional life.

videos.title: A Wanted (Inhu)man
videos.overview: Daisy, Mack and Coulson race to protect Lincoln as Rosalind’s team hunts down the Inhuman in their quest for powered people. Meanwhile, Hunter proves that there is no line that he will not cross to exact his revenge against Ward and HYDRA.

videos.title: Devils You Know
videos.overview: Coulson and the team search for the Inhuman who is killing other Inhumans. Meanwhile, May feels that Hunter's mission to take down Ward is getting too personal.

videos.title: 4,722 Hours
videos.overview: After her dramatic rescue from another planet, Simmons is still reeling from her ordeal and reveals how she had to fight for her life in a harsh new world.

videos.title: Among Us Hide...
videos.overview: The stakes get even higher as Hunter and May continue to go after Ward and HYDRA, and Daisy and Coulson begin to suspect that the ATCU may be keeping a big secret from S.H.I.E.L.D.

videos.title: Chaos Theory
videos.overview: As Daisy and the team fight to protect Inhumans, S.H.I.E.L.D. discovers the shocking truth about one of their foes; Fitz helps Simmons recover information that could lead them back through the portal.

videos.title: Many Heads, One Tale
videos.overview: The S.H.I.E.L.D. team discovers dangerous truths about the ATCU, and Ward's plans to destroy S.H.I.E.L.D. take a surprising twist.

videos.title: Closure
videos.overview: Ward's campaign for revenge brings the S.H.I.E.L.D. team to their knees, and Coulson proves he will do anything to settle the score.

videos.title: Maveth
videos.overview: S.H.I.E.L.D battles HYDRA head-to-head, which sees Coulson and Fitz take the ultimate risk while Daisy and the Inhumans try to keep HYDRA at bay.

videos.title: Bouncing Back
videos.overview: In the aftermath of his trip to Maveth, Coulson is more determined than ever to get to Gideon Malick and put an end to HYDRA once and for all. Daisy and the team encounter more Inhumans who have powers like they've never seen before, but will they be friends or enemies of S.H.I.E.L.D.?

videos.title: The Inside Man
videos.overview: Coulson and General Talbot are forced to team up and attend a worldwide symposium on Inhumans, where they suspect Malick has an inside man. As the S.H.I.E.L.D. team gets closer to the truth, an unexpected traitor is revealed.

videos.title: Parting Shot
videos.overview: Bobbi and Hunter become ensnared in an assassination plot after tracking Malick to Russia. As S.H.I.E.L.D. races to save the lives on the line, the team is changed forever.

videos.title: Watchdogs
videos.overview: When a radical group called The Watchdogs emerges with plans to eliminate the Inhumans, Agent Mack and his brother become caught in the crossfire. Meanwhile, Simmons discovers a powerful chemical compound that could alter the future for Inhumans.

videos.title: Spacetime
videos.overview: When Daisy gets a horrifying glimpse of the future, S.H.I.E.L.D. races to prove that fate is not fixed.

videos.title: Paradise Lost
videos.overview: S.H.I.E.L.D. hunts for information on their dangerous new enemy, and a shameful secret from Malick's past is exposed, threatening to destroy his HYDRA legacy.

videos.title: The Team
videos.overview: Agent Daisy Johnson must call upon the Secret Warriors for an inaugural mission that will leave no member unscathed, and S.H.I.E.L.D. learns more about Hive's powers, forcing them to question everyone they trust.

videos.title: The Singularity
videos.overview: The S.H.I.E.L.D. team is left reeling and decimated as Hive continues to sway Inhumans to his side. But there is a sliver of hope as Agents Fitz and Simmons follow a lead that may be able to stop the maniacal Inhuman once and for all.

videos.title: Failed Experiments
videos.overview: Coulson and his team race to combat Hive's control over the Inhumans, as their enemy's deadly plan for the human race is revealed.

videos.title: Emancipation
videos.overview: In the aftermath of the events of Captain America: Civil War, S.H.I.E.L.D. feels pressure to reveal their involvement with Inhumans. But with the stakes higher than ever and Hive growing stronger, the team is tested in ways they could never anticipate.

videos.title: Absolution (1)
videos.overview: S.H.I.E.L.D. takes on Hive, and when his master plan is finally revealed, the team must spring into action.

videos.title: Ascension (2)
videos.overview: As Hive prepares to convert the world into his personal army, S.H.I.E.L.D. scrambles to mount a counteroffensive. Who's going to pay the ultimate price to ensure that the mission is a success?

videos.title: The Ghost
videos.overview: Daisy has left S.H.I.E.L.D. and is trying to solve the mystery of a bunch of serial killings in the Los Angeles area. At the same time her old friends suspect her for the killings and are following her trail in an attempt to find her.

videos.title: Meet the New Boss
videos.overview: Daisy goes to battle Ghost Rider at a terrible cost, and Coulson faces the new Director, and his bold agenda surprises them all.

videos.title: Uprising
videos.overview: As Coulson, Mack and Fitz attempt to track down and neutralize a rogue group looking to end Inhuman Registration worldwide, Simmons and Dr. Radcliffe only have hours to save May before she succumbs forever to her mysterious illness.

videos.title: Let Me Stand Next to Your Fire
videos.overview: As Ghost Rider's quest for vengeance brings him into an explosive confrontation with S.H.I.E.L.D., Coulson and Mack must rely on an unlikely ally in their time of desperate need; and Daisy reunites with a familiar face to stop the Watchdogs.

videos.title: Lockup
videos.overview: As Robbie Reyes struggles to control the Ghost Rider, S.H.I.E.L.D. infiltrates a high-security prison to unravel the secrets that haunt them all.

videos.title: The Good Samaritan
videos.overview: Robbie's shocking story on how he became Ghost Rider is finally discovered as Coulson and his team's lives hang in the balance.

videos.title: Deals with Our Devils
videos.overview: With the loss of half the team, the remaining members search for answers as the clock counts down for Ghost Rider.

videos.title: The Laws of Inferno Dynamics
videos.overview: S.H.I.E.L.D. and Ghost Rider find themselves unlikely allies when the lives of all of Los Angeles hang in the balance.

videos.title: Broken Promises
videos.overview: Coulson is unaware of a dark secret May is hiding, even as the two grow closer; Aida is determined to find the Darkhold.

videos.title: The Patriot
videos.overview: Separated from their team, Coulson and Mack discover a shocking secret about Mace, leaving all of S.H.I.E.L.D. in a precarious position.

videos.title: Wake Up
videos.overview: May works to uncover the truth about what happened to her; Aida's next move puts everyone's life at risk.

videos.title: Hot Potato Soup
videos.overview: Agents Sam and Billy Koenig are hunted down to get at the Darkhold book, and only Phil Coulson and the team can save them before the clock ticks out.

videos.title: BOOM
videos.overview: Daisy, Director Mace and the S.H.I.E.L.D. team must find a way to contain an explosive Inhuman. Meanwhile, Coulson and Mack come face-to-face with Radcliffe’s inspiration for Aida.

videos.title: The Man Behind the Shield
videos.overview: Mace fights for his life while Coulson and team find themselves in a deadly cat-and-mouse game as they attempt his rescue.

videos.title: Self Control
videos.overview: Suspicion turns to paranoia when the team doesn't know who can be trusted as more LMDs infiltrate S.H.I.E.L.D.

videos.title: What If...
videos.overview: Daisy and Simmons uncover secrets and lies in a world gone mad. With HYDRA in control, they are our only hope to save everyone.

videos.title: Identity and Change
videos.overview: As Daisy and Simmons struggle to discover an escape route to the real world, the identity of the Inhuman leader of the Resistance is revealed.

videos.title: No Regrets
videos.overview: The truth behind Fitz's turn could bring down all of S.H.I.E.L.D..

videos.title: All the Madame's Men
videos.overview: Daisy finds herself teamed up with an unlikely partner. Meanwhile, Aida prepares to put her ultimate end game into effect.

videos.title: Farewell, Cruel World!
videos.overview: The clock is ticking for Daisy and Simmons to get the team out of the Framework, but not everyone is ready and willing to leave.

videos.title: The Return
videos.overview: Coulson and the team's victory in the Framework is short-lived, as an even deadlier enemy looms against them all.

videos.title: World's End
videos.overview: With the surprising emergence of Ghost Rider, Coulson and the team attempt to stop Aida from ending the world.

videos.title: Orientation (1)
videos.overview: Coulson and the team find themselves stranded on a mysterious ship in outer space, and that's just the beginning of the nightmare to come.

videos.title: Orientation (2)
videos.overview: Coulson and the team find themselves stranded on a mysterious ship in outer space, and that's just the beginning of the nightmare to come.

videos.title: A Life Spent
videos.overview: Daisy decides she will rescue Simmons, even if it means risking everything to do it.

videos.title: A Life Earned
videos.overview: Coulson and the team discover what their captors' true intentions are, and in space, escape is not an option.

videos.title: Rewind
videos.overview: With the surprising help of Lance Hunter, nothing will stop Fitz from finding the lost team as his incredible journey is revealed.

videos.title: Fun & Games
videos.overview: With Daisy's life on the line, an unexpected friend attempts to rescue her.

videos.title: Together or Not at All
videos.overview: Just as the team reunites, they become prey to an undefeated Kree warrior bent on killing them all.

videos.title: The Last Day
videos.overview: Coulson and the team discover that the most unexpected person from S.H.I.E.L.D.’s past may hold the key to stopping Earth’s destruction.

videos.title: Best Laid Plans
videos.overview: Mack, Yo-Yo, and Flint fight to keep everyone alive by starting a revolution against the Kree.

videos.title: Past Life
videos.overview: The team has one final chance to return to the timeline, but their actions may have deadly consequences.

videos.title: All the Comforts of Home
videos.overview: Coulson and the team set out to rewrite the course of humanity's fate; they're unaware that their efforts will dramatically change one S.H.I.E.L.D. agent's life.

videos.title: The Real Deal
videos.overview: In the milestone 100th episode, Coulson finally reveals the mysterious deal he made with Ghost Rider, which will impact everyone on the team.

videos.title: Principia
videos.overview: The team goes in search of Gravitonium in order to save the world.

videos.title: The Devil Complex
videos.overview: As Fitz and Simmons race to find a way to seal the Rift, they are faced with one of their greatest fears manifested.

videos.title: Rise and Shine
videos.overview: Coulson uncovers General Hale's true agenda, and it could be the end of the world if S.H.I.E.L.D. doesn't help her.

videos.title: Inside Voices
videos.overview: Coulson is forced to team up with surprising allies to save the world, while the S.H.I.E.L.D. team attempts to track down and rescue him.

videos.title: The Honeymoon
videos.overview: While an agent's life hangs in the balance, Fitz, Simmons, and Yo-Yo attempt to neutralize a weapon that could play a role in Earth’s destruction.

videos.title: All Roads Lead…
videos.overview: The team must find a way to stop Ruby before the prophesied chain reaction that can destroy the Earth is put into motion.

videos.title: Option Two
videos.overview: Coulson and the team find themselves under siege at the Lighthouse.

videos.title: The One Who Will Save Us All
videos.overview: A newly determined Talbot takes Coulson to meet the enemy and attempts to avert Earth's destruction.

videos.title: The Force of Gravity
videos.overview: Daisy's future as the Destroyer of Worlds could take a critical change.

videos.title: The End
videos.overview: Coulson's life or death is the challenge the team finds themselves in, as the wrong decision will cause the Destruction of Earth.

videos.title: Missing Pieces
videos.overview: Scattered across the galaxy, the team works to find their footing in the wake of losing Coulson.

videos.title: Window of Opportunity
videos.overview: While Fitz and Enoch struggle in space, Sarge and his team move forward with their mysterious mission on Earth.

videos.title: Fear and Loathing on the Planet of Kitson
videos.overview: It’s a wild night out on the planet of Kitson for the agents. While Leo and Enoch try their luck at the casino, nearby, Daisy and Simmons find themselves in a much... groovier situation.

videos.title: Code Yellow
videos.overview: Yo-Yo and Keller take things public; parasitic aliens threaten the human race; and someone really needs boba.

videos.title: The Other Thing
videos.overview: Sarge has May; Atarah has Daisy, Enoch and Simmons; and now, there are two planets that need saving.

videos.title: Inescapable
videos.overview: They've fought through space, time and alternate realities to find each other, and now, closer than ever, only their own demons can stop FitzSimmons' reunion.

videos.title: Toldja
videos.overview: After finding themselves in yet another gambling dilemma, a mysterious stranger offers Enoch and FitzSimmons a ride home where, it turns out, two shrikes aren’t better than one.

videos.title: Collision Course (1)
videos.overview: To face The Galaxy-Hopping Hate-Beast That Eats Planets, the team on Earth asks for help in all the wrong places. While back on the Lazy Comet, something weird is going on with Izel’s crew, and it’s not just the puffies.

videos.title: Collision Course (2)
videos.overview: No time for the team to play catch-up, there's a planet to save.

videos.title: Leap
videos.overview: The party’s over, and now the team must trust each other in order to face impending doom and an enemy that’s closer than they think.

videos.title: From the Ashes
videos.overview: Out of answers and running out of time, the agents must face the ghosts of their past in order to move forward.

videos.title: The Sign
videos.overview: With time running short, the team will have to go to hell and back to stop the end of everything.

videos.title: New Life
videos.overview: Who will survive? It all comes down to this.

videos.title: The New Deal
videos.overview: Coulson and the Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. are thrust backward in time and stranded in 1931 New York City. With the all-new Zephyr set to time-jump at any moment, the team must hurry to find out exactly what happened. If they fail, it would mean disaster for the past, present and future of the world.

videos.title: Know Your Onions
videos.overview: With the identity of the timeline-unraveling "thread" revealed, the team's mission to protect him at all costs leads each agent to question their own values. Is preserving the future of the world as they know it worth the destruction they could prevent?

videos.title: Alien Commies from the Future!
videos.overview: A surprise leap forward in time has stranded Enoch in 1931 and landed the team in yet another unfamiliar decade. Now, in order to stop the Chronicoms from launching their newest future-dismantling plan, the agents will have to infiltrate one of S.H.I.E.L.D.’s most secure bases. They won’t be able to succeed without help from a familiar face or two.

videos.title: Out of the Past
videos.overview: It was just another average morning on July 22, 1955, when Agent Phil Coulson realized the importance of that day in the S.H.I.E.L.D. history books. With a chip on his shoulder and a genre-bending glitch in his system, he’d set into motion a chain of events that would hopefully preserve the timeline as we know it and ensure those pesky Chronicoms get the ending they deserve. What could go wrong?

videos.title: A Trout in the Milk
videos.overview: After a bumpy landing in the disco decade, the team – Daniel Sousa in tow – reunites with more than one familiar face at the S.H.I.E.L.D. hangout and discovers exactly how to dismantle the Chronicoms’ latest plan. But when they get too close for comfort, the Zephyr unexpectedly leaps forward again, this time to a date pivotal to not only the future of S.H.I.E.L.D. but to the future of Director Mack as well.

videos.title: Adapt or Die
videos.overview: The stakes are higher than ever when, after blowing their cover and damaging the Zephyr in the process, the team must scramble to rescue Mack’s parents, save S.H.I.E.L.D. from a Chronicom infestation, and fix the ship … all before the next time-jump. Meanwhile, Daisy and Sousa find themselves at a disadvantage against a power hungry Nathaniel Malick and his goons, and Coulson will have to do the thing he does best in order to save the future.

videos.title: The Totally Excellent Adventures of Mack and The D
videos.overview: After being unexpectedly stranded in 1982, Mack retreats to his childhood home to process the death of his parents, while Deke gets to work scouting a chart-topping group of new agents. With no idea if or when the team is coming back for them, time seems to finally be on their side … at least until the killer robots show up.

videos.title: After, Before
videos.overview: With the Zephyr’s time drive malfunctioning, the team is quite literally hurling toward disaster and Yo-Yo may be their only hope. The only problem? To get her powers back, she’ll need to enlist the help of an old adversary and revisit part of her past long hidden away.

videos.title: As I Have Always Been
videos.overview: A time storm ravages the Zephyr, propelling it toward destruction while simultaneously forcing Daisy and Coulson to relive their failed attempts to save the team over and over, until they find a solution or are swallowed by the storm. Making it to their next destination will take trust, courage and sacrifice from everyone on board, but it will all come down to having enough time.

videos.title: Stolen
videos.overview: After Enoch’s sacrifice propelled them out of the time storm, the team arrives back in 1983 where Nathaniel and Kora are hard at work building an army of hand-selected anarchist Inhumans at Afterlife. When the agents split up to cover more ground, Daisy is tasked with protecting Jiaying and is compelled to confront her mother for the first time since her death; while the others quickly learn they’ll need to face yet another supercharged former enemy in order to stop Malick.

videos.title: Brand New Day
videos.overview: With the help of Kora on the inside, Sibyl and Nathaniel continue their fight to shape a dark new future for S.H.I.E.L.D., managing to stay one step ahead of the agents along the way. If the team is going to turn this one around, they’ll have to get creative, and maybe even a little out of this world.

videos.title: The End Is at Hand
videos.overview: With their backs against the wall and Nathaniel and Sibyl edging ever closer to eliminating S.H.I.E.L.D. from the history books, the agents must rely on their strengths to outsmart and outlast the Chronicoms. This is their most important fight, and it will take the help of friends and teammates, past and present, to survive.

This is their most important fight, and it will take the help of friends and teammates, past and present, to survive.
